section.15: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

15.name_native: The Book of Shortening the Prayer When Traveling

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:"We used to travel with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) between Makkah and Al-Madinah, fearing nothing but Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and praying two rak'ahs
